panels.description: Hours since the most recent ingestion (ingested_utc) for every curve in $area, across realised prices (timeseries) and day-ahead inputs (forecasts). Uses ingestion time, not data timestamp, so day-ahead horizons do not read as stale. Green < 26h, amber 26-48h, red > 48h.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT curve_name, dateDiff('hour', max(ingested_utc), now()) AS hours_since_ingest
FROM (
  SELECT curve_name, ingested_utc FROM algo.timeseries FINAL WHERE area = '${area}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT curve_name, ingested_utc FROM algo.forecasts FINAL WHERE area = '${area}'
)
GROUP BY curve_name
ORDER BY hours_since_ingest DESC

panels.title: Ingestion freshness — hours since last ingest

panels.description: How many hours of future (day-ahead) data each curve currently holds: max(timestamp_utc) - now(). A healthy day-ahead pipeline sits around 12-36h. Red < 6h, amber 6-18h, green > 18h. If a curve drops low, tomorrow's forecast inputs are missing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT curve_name, dateDiff('hour', now(), max(timestamp_utc)) AS horizon_hours
FROM (
  SELECT curve_name, timestamp_utc FROM algo.timeseries FINAL WHERE area = '${area}'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT curve_name, timestamp_utc FROM algo.forecasts FINAL WHERE area = '${area}'
)
GROUP BY curve_name
ORDER BY horizon_hours ASC

panels.title: Day-ahead horizon coverage

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, table_name AS metric, row_count AS value
FROM (
  SELECT toDate(timestamp_utc) AS day, 'timeseries' AS table_name, count() AS row_count
  FROM algo.timeseries FINAL
  WHERE area = '${area}' AND timestamp_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toDate(timestamp_utc) AS day, 'forecasts' AS table_name, count() AS row_count
  FROM algo.forecasts FINAL
  WHERE area = '${area}' AND timestamp_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY day
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toDate(timestamp_utc) AS day, 'experiment_predictions' AS table_name, count() AS row_count
  FROM algo.experiment_predictions AS ep FINAL
  INNER JOIN algo.experiment_runs AS er FINAL ON ep.run_id = er.run_id
  WHERE er.area = '${area}' AND timestamp_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY day
)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.description: Rows ingested per day keyed on ingested_utc (not the data's timestamp). A missing or short bar means the ingestion pipeline did not run that day. Use it to spot pipeline downtime that the data-date row counts can hide.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT toDate(ingested_utc) AS time, 'price (timeseries)' AS metric, count() AS value
  FROM algo.timeseries FINAL
  WHERE area = '${area}' AND ingested_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toDate(ingested_utc) AS time, 'forecasts' AS metric, count() AS value
  FROM algo.forecasts FINAL
  WHERE area = '${area}' AND ingested_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY time
)
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Ingestion Gaps By Ingest Date

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDate(timestamp_utc) AS time, countIf(value = 0) AS zero_values
FROM algo.timeseries FINAL
WHERE area = '${area}'
  AND curve_name LIKE 'ENTSOE ${area} EnergyPrice %'
  AND timestamp_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT day AS time, greatest(24 - observed_hours, 0) AS missing_hours
FROM (
  SELECT toDate(timestamp_utc) AS day, countDistinct(toHour(timestamp_utc)) AS observed_hours
  FROM algo.timeseries FINAL
  WHERE area = '${area}'
    AND curve_name LIKE 'ENTSOE ${area} EnergyPrice %'
    AND timestamp_utc >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY day
)
ORDER BY time
